classification.difficultyReason: Find the missing trapezium width, calculate the two component areas and add them.

content.prompt: The diagram shows the cross-section of a squash court. Find the area of the cross-section.

spec.description: Upright cross-section with a horizontal base, left vertical side, short horizontal top, descending upper-right edge and right vertical side. A solid vertical line divides left rectangle A from right trapezium B. External dimension arrows and all three source right-angle markers are retained. The source's uniform light grey fill is intentionally omitted; the dividing line and region labels remain.
spec.mathematics: Base 4.6 m; left height 10 m; upper horizontal length 2.1 m; right height 6 m. Region A is a rectangle. Region B has parallel vertical sides of 10 m and 6 m, separated horizontally by 4.6 − 2.1 = 2.5 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, region labels and structural marks are visible. The derived 2.5 m width and all area calculations are answer-only.
